description: A spread of playing cards sits across the tabletop, with a small pile of cards near the right edge and more cards stacked near the bottom center. The left hand steadies the small bottom stack with the ace of hearts on top while the right hand, holding a nine of diamonds as a right-hand object, moves it leftward toward the center, then lifts and shifts it to the right-side pile and releases it to gather it with the other cards.
